_comment: Cross-engine parity contract for the transition progress easing curve.
Both ease the 0..1 transition progress before it reaches the shared WGSL.
Scope: the four named curves with DEFAULT params (no curveBulge/curveOffset).
KNOWN INTENTIONAL DIVERGENCE (NOT covered): custom curve params (curveBulge /
curveOffset) are honored by the web engine only; the native engine ignores them.
Unknown curve names: web defaults to the 'smooth' bezier, native to linear.
